# Brand Strategy Productization Blueprint

## Part 1 — Atomic Decomposition

**Deliverables**
- Brand audit (competitive landscape + current-state assessment)
- Positioning statement
- Messaging framework (value props, proof points, objection handling)
- Voice & tone guide
- Naming / tagline recommendations
- Visual direction brief (mood, not execution)
- Brand guide PDF (final deliverable)
- Internal rollout kit (slides, talking points for leadership)
- Agency/designer handoff doc

**Time blocks**
- 60-min kickoff
- 45-min stakeholder interviews (per interview)
- 90-min positioning workshop
- 60-min messaging workshop
- 60-min presentation of final guide
- 30-min check-ins (weekly during engagement)

**Access tiers**
- Async Slack/email (48hr response)
- Async Slack/email (24hr response)
- Direct phone/text + weekly live calls

**Support levels**
- Zero revisions (as-delivered)
- 1 round of revisions per deliverable
- 2 rounds + 30-day post-delivery async support
- 90-day embed (ongoing consultation)

**Customizations**
- # of stakeholder interviews (3 / 6 / 10+)
- B2B vs B2C vs B2B2C framing
- Internal-only vs agency-handoff-ready output
- Industry specialization depth (generalist / vertical-trained)
- Rebrand vs. new brand vs. refinement

---

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | Research + interview thoroughness | Light (3 interviews, desk research) / Standard (6 interviews, competitive audit) / Deep (10+ interviews, customer research, category analysis) | Deep blocked at Sprint pace |
| **Breadth** | Brand-system scope | Verbal-only (positioning + messaging) / +Voice (adds tone + voice guide) / Full system (adds visual direction + naming) | Naming requires +Voice minimum |
| **Pace** | Calendar timeline | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Embedded (10–12 weeks) | Sprint blocks Deep depth; Embedded requires Standard+ depth |
| **Format** | Final deliverable form | Working doc (Notion/Google Doc) / Branded PDF guide / Guide + rollout kit | Rollout kit requires Branded PDF |
| **Support** | Revisions + post-delivery access | As-delivered / 1 round / 2 rounds + 30-day async / 90-day embed | 90-day embed only with Embedded pace |
| **Handoff** | Who consumes the output | Internal team only / Agency-handoff-ready (includes designer brief + spec) | Agency-handoff requires Full system breadth |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Naming without +Voice breadth
- Rollout kit without Branded PDF format
- 90-day embed without Embedded pace
- Agency-handoff without Full system breadth
- Embedded pace + Light depth (wastes the timeline)

---

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Lite — **Positioning Sprint** — $6,500
- **Configuration:** Depth: Light · Breadth: Verbal-only · Pace: Sprint (2wk) · Format: Working doc · Support: 1 round · Handoff: Internal
- **Positioning line:** For founders who know their brand is muddled but can't justify a full engagement — get a sharp positioning statement and messaging framework in 2 weeks.
- **Pricing logic:** ~43% of flagship. Anchored against the cost of 6 months of bad positioning (missed deals, confused marketing hires). Entry point that converts to Core later.

### Core — **Brand Guide** *(flagship)* — $15,000
- **Configuration:** Depth: Standard · Breadth: +Voice · Pace: Standard (6wk) · Format: Branded PDF · Support: 2 rounds + 30-day async · Handoff: Internal
- **Positioning line:** For funded startups and growing companies that need a complete brand foundation — positioning, messaging, voice — documented and defensible.
- **Pricing logic:** Current anchor. Senior-strategist-only pricing well below typical agency brand engagements ($25–50K) that bundle design.

### Premium — **Brand System + Embed** — $32,000
- **Configuration:** Depth: Deep · Breadth: Full system · Pace: Embedded (10–12wk) · Format: Guide + rollout kit · Support: 90-day embed · Handoff: Agency-handoff-ready
- **Positioning line:** For Series A/B companies or pre-rebrand teams who need naming, visual direction, and a strategist embedded through rollout.
- **Pricing logic:** Below consultancy retainer math ($10K/mo × 3 + naming ~$12K = $42K sum-of-parts). Feels like a discount vs. hiring a boutique agency.

---

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard +$3,500 · Standard → Deep +$5,500
- Breadth: Verbal → +Voice +$2,500 · +Voice → Full system +$6,000 (includes naming)
- Pace: Sprint → Standard +$1,500 · Standard → Embedded +$4,500
- Format: Working doc → Branded PDF +$1,500 · +Rollout kit +$2,500
- Support: 1 round → 2 rounds + 30-day +$2,000 · → 90-day embed +$6,500
- Handoff: Internal → Agency-handoff-ready +$3,000

**Floor:** $6,500 (anything below isn't a brand engagement — route to a paid consult call instead)

**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium flagship or custom-scoped proposal

**Configurator dependencies (enforced):**
- All invalid combinations from Part 2 block submission
- Selecting Naming auto-upgrades Breadth to Full system
- Selecting 90-day embed auto-upgrades Pace to Embedded
- Agency-handoff auto-upgrades Breadth to Full system

**Flagship-protection check:**
- BYO-to-Core config: $6,500 + $3,500 + $2,500 + $1,500 + $1,500 + $2,000 = **$17,500** (vs. $15,000 flagship ✓)
- BYO-to-Premium config: $6,500 + $5,500 + $8,500 + $4,500 + $4,000 + $6,500 + $3,000 = **$38,500** (vs. $32,000 flagship ✓)

Both flagships remain the rational discount.

### Tier 2 — Signature *(Core, flagship)*
- **Configuration:** Fully custom depth · Training+Nutrition breadth · Biweekly pace · App + live calls · Voxer 24h · Macro targets · Weekly check-in
- **Positioning line:** The complete coaching relationship — custom programming, nutrition, and a coach who knows your week.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$B/month` — anchored at your current 1-on-1 rate (this *is* your current offering, productized). Flagship discount vs. BYO sum of equivalent config.

### Tier 3 — Elite *(Premium)*
- **Configuration:** Fully custom depth · Training+Nutrition+Lifestyle breadth · Weekly pace · App + live calls · Voxer same-day · Full meal plan · Daily habit tracking · Quarterly deep-dive add-on
- **Positioning line:** For clients treating their body like a performance project — maximum access, maximum precision.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$C/month` — anchored ~2–2.5× flagship; priced below "concierge" / executive health coaching ($2–5K/mo) but clearly premium tier.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** `+$A/month` (Foundation config)
- **Per-dimension upgrades** (monthly add-ons):
  - Fully custom depth: `+$d1`
  - Add Nutrition breadth: `+$d2` · Add Lifestyle: `+$d3`
  - Biweekly pace: `+$d4` · Weekly pace: `+$d5`
  - Live calls format: `+$d6`
  - Voxer 24h: `+$d7` · Voxer same-day: `+$d8`
  - Macro targets: `+$d9` · Full meal plan: `+$d10`
  - Daily habit tracking: `+$d11`
  - Form-check pack: `+$d12` · Quarterly deep-dive: `+$d13`

- **Floor:** Foundation base (`+$A`) — anything less isn't coaching, it's a template sale.
- **Ceiling:** If BYO config total exceeds `~1.8× flagship` OR client selects Weekly pace + Same-day access + Full meal plan + Lifestyle breadth → auto-route to Elite (or custom quote).

- **Configurator dependencies to enforce:** all "Invalid combinations" from Part 2, plus:
  - Selecting any live-call format auto-requires Semi-custom or Fully custom depth
  - Selecting Full meal plan auto-adds Training+Nutrition breadth
  - Selecting Weekly pace flags Email-only as incompatible

- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO sum to reach the Signature configuration must price **above** `+$B` by ~15–20%. Signature must remain the rational discount for the "full coaching relationship" buyer. Same for Elite vs. maxed-out BYO.

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | How thorough the blueprint + follow-up | Single-shot / Iterated (self-critique pass) / Operator-reviewed | Operator-reviewed requires Priority or DFY tier |
| **Breadth** | Vertical/domain packs loaded | Core only / +1 pack / All packs / Custom pack authored | Custom pack requires Team or White-label |
| **Pace** | Cadence of use | Ad-hoc / Metered monthly / Unlimited / Retainer | Retainer requires named operator |
| **Format** | Output surface | Markdown only / +Configurator schema (JSON/YAML) / +Hosted shareable artifact / +Platform-specific (Typeform/Webflow/Framer) | Platform-specific requires schema format enabled |
| **Memory** | Persistence + sharing | None / Personal / Team-shared / Cross-workspace | Team-shared requires Team seats; Cross-workspace requires White-label |
| **Branding** | Who the skill appears to be from | Claude-branded / Neutral / White-labeled with user's brand | White-labeled is top-tier only |
| **Support** | Response + channel | Community / Email 48hr / Priority 24hr / Dedicated Slack / Named operator | Named operator requires DFY or Retainer |
| **Discipline Mix** *(domain-specific)* | Which practitioner archetypes get first-class treatment in the output (consultant / coach / agency / dev-shop / productized-service operator) | Single archetype / Multi-archetype / All | Multi+ requires at least +1 pack on Breadth |
| **Self-Iteration** *(domain-specific)* | Whether the meta-loop (skill improves itself) runs on the user's instance | Off / Manual trigger / Scheduled / Continuous with PR review | Continuous requires Team or White-label |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- White-labeled + Claude-branded memory artifacts (brand collision)
- Retainer pace + Community-only support (incoherent SLA)
- Cross-workspace memory + Personal tier (data boundary violation)
- Platform-specific format + Markdown-only format (contradiction)
- Named operator + Ad-hoc pace (operator needs cadence to be useful)
- Custom pack authoring + Single-shot depth (authoring requires iteration)

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

Renamed in the Clay vocabulary: **Open Clay / Studio / Foundry**, plus the free OSS core that remains MIT forever.

### Tier 0 — **MIT Core** (free, unchanged)
The skill stays open-source, unlimited, forkable. This is the top of the funnel, not a tier to buy. Keep it generous — it's the moat.

### Tier 1 — **Open Clay** *(Lite)*
- **Configuration:** Depth: Iterated · Breadth: Core + 1 pack · Pace: Metered monthly (e.g., 50 runs) · Format: Markdown + JSON/YAML schema · Memory: Personal · Branding: Claude-branded · Support: Email 48hr · Discipline Mix: Single · Self-Iteration: Manual
- **Positioning:** For the solo consultant or coach who's already using the free skill and wants persistent memory across their productization runs plus configurator schemas they can paste into their funnel.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$A/mo` — anchored against the price of a single hour of the user's own consulting; must feel like "one billable hour buys me a month of leverage."

### Tier 2 — **Studio** *(Core — flagship)*
- **Configuration:** Depth: Iterated · Breadth: All packs · Pace: Unlimited · Format: Markdown + JSON/YAML + hosted shareable artifacts + platform-specific (Typeform/Webflow/Framer) · Memory: Team-shared · Branding: Neutral (remove Claude marks) · Support: Priority 24hr + Dedicated Slack · Discipline Mix: Multi-archetype · Self-Iteration: Scheduled
- **Positioning:** For the boutique agency or multi-coach practice productizing multiple offerings for themselves and their clients — unlimited runs, shared team memory, neutral branding so blueprints look native in client decks.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$B/mo` — anchored against the loaded cost of one junior strategist (~$6–10K/mo fully loaded in most markets). Must sit meaningfully below that line so the buy decision is obvious. Flagship — this is where the margin lives.

### Tier 3 — **Foundry** *(Premium)*
- **Configuration:** Depth: Operator-reviewed · Breadth: All packs + custom pack authored for the buyer's vertical · Pace: Retainer · Format: All formats + white-label export · Memory: Cross-workspace · Branding: White-labeled · Support: Named operator + quarterly strategy reviews · Discipline Mix: All · Self-Iteration: Continuous with PR review
- **Positioning:** For the agency or network that wants to *resell Clay-powered productization* to their own clients — their brand, their custom vertical pack, a named operator on retainer, and the self-iteration loop running continuously on their fork.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$C/mo` or `+$C` setup + retainer — anchored against (a) what the buyer charges their *own* clients for a single productization engagement, and (b) a typical fractional-head retainer ($15–40K/mo range depending on scope). Below sum-of-parts if bought separately (custom pack authoring + named operator + white-label license).
